items.title: Introducing Qwen
items.summary: 4 months after our first release of Qwen-7B, which is the starting point of our opensource journey of large language models (LLM), we now provide an introduction to the Qwen series to give you a whole picture of our work as well as our objectives. Below are important links to our opensource projects and community. PAPER GITHUB HUGGING FACE MODELSCOPE DISCORD Additionally, we have WeChat groups for chatting and we inv
items.summaryZh: 本文在Qwen-7B发布四个月后，系统介绍了通义千问大语言模型系列的整体工作、开源愿景与技术目标。文章汇总了包括论文、GitHub代码库、Hugging Face模型权重以及ModelScope在内的重要开源项目链接，并展示了通义千问在开源社区持续建设多模态与语言模型生态的完整战略布局。

aiReview.reasonZh: 文章全面介绍了通义千问（Qwen）系列大语言模型的开源进展与整体规划，对了解该系列开源生态具有重要参考价值。
